description: Returns the commands recently run on one server through Opservo (terminal, quick actions, approved fixes, automation), sorted newest to oldest, with source, exit code and the start of their output.
name: get_recent_commands

exit_code.description: Process exit code, null while running.

source.description: Where it came from: terminal, quick_action, ai_fix, fleet_run and so on.

status.description: queued, dispatched, done, error, expired or cancelled.

stderr.description: Start of standard error (truncated at 2000 characters).

stdout.description: Start of standard output (truncated at 2000 characters).

error.description: Present only when the call failed: why, in plain English (unknown server, server from another workspace, not a Kubernetes cluster).

title: Recent commands (history)
